transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling Cymbal Telecom. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Hi Alex. I'm looking to add a new line to my account for my son, and I also want to get him a new phone.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Absolutely, I can definitely help you with that. To get started and access your account, could I please get your full name?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Sure, it's David Gonzalez.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you, David. And the phone number you're calling from, does it end in 7405?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes, that's the one.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Perfect. For security, the last step is to verify your four-digit account security PIN. Can you please provide that for me?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes, my PIN is 5-7-4-0.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you. Let me just validate that... one moment.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Excellent, that's a match. I have your account pulled up now, Mr. Gonzalez. Thank you for your patience with that security check.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: No problem at all. Safety first.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I see you're currently on our Unlimited 5G Mobile Plan. Adding a second line is very straightforward and actually gives you a multi-line discount.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Oh, a discount? How does that work?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes. Right now you pay sixty-five dollars for your single line. When you add a second line, the price per line drops to fifty-five dollars. So your new monthly total for the two lines of service would be one hundred and ten dollars, plus taxes.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: So, instead of paying sixty-five plus another sixty-five, it's fifty-five for each? That's a good deal.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That's correct. It's our way of thanking families for choosing Cymbal Telecom.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: And the new line for my son... it gets the same unlimited data and everything that I have?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, it's the exact same plan. Unlimited talk, text, and 5G data, plus 15 gigabytes of mobile hotspot data per line.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay, that sounds perfect. Let's go ahead and do that.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Great. Now, let's talk about the new phone. You mentioned wanting to get one for him. Did you have a particular model in mind?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes, he's been saving up and wants to put his money towards an iPhone 15 Pro.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: An excellent choice. The iPhone 15 Pro is a fantastic device. We offer it on a monthly installment plan, which a lot of our customers prefer. Let me check the current pricing and availability.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay, thanks.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Alright... I see we have the iPhone 15 Pro in stock. What storage capacity were you thinking of? The base model is 128 gigabytes.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: He takes a lot of videos, so maybe the next one up? What's after 128?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The next step up is 256 gigabytes. That's a very popular choice.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes, let's go with the 256 gigabyte model.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Perfect. And do you have a color preference? We have Natural Titanium, Blue Titanium, White Titanium, and Black Titanium.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Hmm, let me think... I think he'd like the Blue Titanium.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Great choice. So, that's one iPhone 15 Pro, 256 gigabytes, in Blue Titanium. Let me pull up the financing details for that specific model.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Sounds good.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Okay, the full retail price for that device is one thousand ninety-nine dollars. We can break that up over our 36-month installment plan with zero percent interest.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Thirty-six months? And how much would that be each month?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Let's see... one thousand ninety-nine divided by thirty-six... that comes out to thirty dollars and fifty-three cents. We just round it to thirty dollars and fifty-five cents per month.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Thirty dollars and fifty-five cents a month for 36 months. Okay. And that's with no interest?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That's correct. Zero percent APR for qualified customers, and your account is in excellent standing, so you qualify.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Great. Are there any other fees? Like an activation fee or something?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That's a great question. There is a one-time activation fee of thirty-five dollars for any new line of service. That charge will appear on your next bill.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay, a one-time thirty-five dollar fee. Got it. So, just to be clear, my monthly bill will go up by how much in total?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Okay, let's break it down. Your current plan is $65. The new plan for two lines will be $110. And the phone installment is $30.55. So your new total monthly cost, before taxes and fees, will be one hundred forty dollars and fifty-five cents.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: One-forty fifty-five. Okay. That makes sense. The service part and the phone part are separate line items on the bill, right?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Exactly. You'll see one charge for the '2-Line Unlimited 5G Plan' and a separate line item under 'Device Installments' for the iPhone 15 Pro.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Perfect. This all sounds good. Let's proceed with the order.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Wonderful. Before I finalize everything, I am required to give you a full summary of the order. Is that okay?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes, please do.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Okay. We are adding one new mobile line to your account, changing your plan to the 2-Line Unlimited 5G Mobile Plan at a monthly cost of one hundred and ten dollars for service.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Correct.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: We are also processing an order for one new Apple iPhone 15 Pro with 256 gigabytes of storage in the Blue Titanium color.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You are financing this device through the Cymbal Telecom 36-month installment plan, at a monthly cost of thirty dollars and fifty-five cents.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: That's right.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: And you understand there will be a one-time thirty-five dollar activation fee that will appear on your next billing statement.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes, I understand.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Finally, I just need to let you know about pro-rated charges. Your billing cycle starts on the 15th of each month. Since we are adding this line today, your next bill will show a partial charge for the new line for the remainder of this cycle, plus the first full month in advance.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Ah, okay. So the next bill will be a little higher than the normal new amount because of that overlap?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Exactly right. It just happens on the very first bill when you add a new service mid-cycle. After that, it will normalize to the one-forty fifty-five plus tax amount we discussed.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay, that's fine. I've seen that before with other services. Thanks for explaining.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You're welcome. Do you give me your consent to proceed with this order as we've discussed?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes, I consent. Let's do it.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Excellent. I'm going to start processing the order now. First, we need to assign a phone number to the new line. Would you like the system to assign a number with the same area code you have, or do you have a preference?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: The same area code would be great, yes.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Okay. I am provisioning the new line now... This part can take about a minute. Do you mind if I place you on a brief hold while the system works?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: No, that's fine. Go ahead.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you. I'll be right back.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for holding, Mr. Gonzalez. The new line has been successfully created.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Great, that was quick.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The new phone number is... are you ready to write it down?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes, one second... okay, go ahead.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The new number is area code 555... 306... 8821.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Perfect. Now I am placing the order for the iPhone. The shipping address I have on file is 123 Oak Street, Anytown. Is that still the correct address to ship the device to?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes, 123 Oak Street is correct.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Great. I am submitting the hardware order now. This also takes a few moments to communicate with our warehouse system.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: No problem.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Okay, the order has been successfully submitted. I have an order confirmation number for your records. It's C-M-O... that's for Cymbal Mobile Order... followed by 9-0-1-3-3-7-5.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay, let me repeat that. CMO-9013375.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That is correct. You will also receive an email with all of these details, including the order number and a link to track the shipment, within the next hour.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Perfect. And when should I expect the phone to arrive?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Our standard shipping is via courier and typically takes three to five business days. So you can expect it to arrive sometime next week.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay, next week. And the SIM card will be with it?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, a brand new Cymbal Telecom 5G SIM card will be pre-installed in the device. All you'll need to do is turn on the phone and follow the on-screen activation instructions.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: So I don't need to call you guys back to activate it?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: No, it should be a completely self-guided process on the phone itself. It will automatically connect to the Cymbal network and activate the new number. If you run into any issues at all, of course, you can call us right back and we'll walk you through it.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: That sounds easy enough. My son is probably better at that stuff than I am anyway.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: (chuckles) I understand completely. Is there anything else I can help you with today, Mr. Gonzalez? Perhaps review any other features of your account?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: No, I think that's everything. You've been very helpful, Alex. You made the process really clear.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: It's my pleasure. I'm glad I could assist. We're excited to have your son join the Cymbal family.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Thanks. He's definitely excited to get the new phone.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I bet! Just to recap one last time, the confirmation email is on its way, the phone ships in 3-5 business days, and your next bill will reflect the pro-rated charges and the new monthly total.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Got it. All clear.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Wonderful. Well, thank you for being a loyal Cymbal Telecom customer.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Thank you, Alex.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling Cymbal Telecom. Have a wonderful rest of your day.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: You too. Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Goodbye.
